results.text: Effects of intracoronary administration of small doses of nicorandil and verapamil on blood pressure and heart rate. Nicorandil and verapamil can improve coronary blood flow and coronary microcirculation during percutaneous coronary intervention. However, the effects of intracoronary (IC) administration of nicorandil and verapamil on hemodynamics remain unclear.
